title: Select the iOS 16.5 userland preparation route by reusing donor tools: record the variants checked and why each was kept or rejected, extend the pinned hakios review files with the unpack/select/mkapfs recipe, and run the donor sysimage/unpack.sh unmodified on the owner's IPSW (staged copy, pinned files hash-checked).
acceptance: The note lists every variant checked (own readers, stock 7-Zip, HackiOS recipe, y2sios, ios-lemonadep, ios-apollo, unused tools) with how it was checked and why it was adopted, kept as reference or rejected; provenance and licences of the adopted tools are stated and tools/sources.py verify hakios is clean after the review list was widened (append only).

The donor unpack.sh ran unmodified from a staged copy of the pinned files on the owner's IPSW (size 6165698198) with exit 0; the note records the numbers it printed and the presence of /sbin/launchd, /usr/lib/dyld, backboardd and SpringBoard, and says that presence is not compatibility.
The note names the confirmed gaps where own code is justified (each with the observation that confirms it) and what is not established; the registry is updated to the chosen path.
steps: Widen the pin and stage the recipe
